title: Glowing trophy
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6a0' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffd700' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd700' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe44d'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffcc00'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e6a800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='goldLight' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff3a0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd700'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Cup body -->
  <path d='M32 20 L68 20 L64 55 Q60 62 50 62 Q40 62 36 55 Z' fill='url(#gold)' stroke='#ffe44d' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Cup top rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='18' ry='5' fill='url(#goldLight)' stroke='#fff3a0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='20' rx='14' ry='3' fill='#ffe680'/>

  <!-- Cup shine highlight -->
  <path d='M40 26 Q42 40 40 52' fill='none' stroke='#fff8cc' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Left handle -->
  <path d='M32 24 Q18 24 18 38 Q18 50 32 50' fill='none' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='4.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M32 24 Q20 24 20 38 Q20 48 32 50' fill='none' stroke='#fff3a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Right handle -->
  <path d='M68 24 Q82 24 82 38 Q82 50 68 50' fill='none' stroke='#ffd700' stroke-width='4.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 24 Q80 24 80 38 Q80 48 68 50' fill='none' stroke='#fff3a0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Star on cup -->
  <polygon points='50,30 52.5,37 60,37 54,41.5 56.5,49 50,44.5 43.5,49 46,41.5 40,37 47.5,37' fill='#fffbe0' stroke='#ffe44d' stroke-width='0.5'/>

  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x='46' y='62' width='8' height='10' rx='1' fill='#e6a800' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='1'/>
  <rect x='47' y='62' width='3' height='10' fill='#fff3a0' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Base top -->
  <rect x='34' y='72' width='32' height='6' rx='2' fill='url(#gold)' stroke='#ffe44d' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Base bottom -->
  <rect x='30' y='78' width='40' height='8' rx='3' fill='#d49a00' stroke='#ffcc00' stroke-width='1'/>
  <rect x='32' y='78' width='36' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe680' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Base plate shine -->
  <rect x='36' y='74' width='12' height='2' rx='1' fill='#fffbe0' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
